answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond in a shared vault before it may transact; the bond is slashed if peers prove misbehavior. New identities start with a tiny kernel of trust and earn higher limits only through a river of verified, useful work over time. A Sybil attacker must fund a separate bond per identity and wait out the same slow ramp, so flooding the network costs real money and time while honest agents pay nothing extra.
